note: After the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. The alate and soldier are described. Soldier measurements: 4 soldiers from 4 colonies, head length 4.90—5.30 mm, maximum head width 4.60—5.00 mm, head height without postmentum 2.60—2.90 mm, frontal tube length 0.18—0.25 mm, left mandible length 2.40—2.80 mm, curvature 0.90—1.15 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.59—0.69 mm. The original is labelled sp. n. (new species). OCR noise has been interpreted from the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is difficult to distinguish from S. dirus; the soldier is distinctly smaller than in S. dirus, less hairy, with the sides of the head straighter and more parallel.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: As in S. dirus. Measurements (2 alates from 1 colony, mm): head length 2.60—2.65; head width without compound eyes 3.05; fontanelle 0.34—0.45; pronotum length 2.00—2.15; pronotum width 3.65—3.85.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule slightly elongate, sides nearly parallel; posterior margin of the head nearly rounded; frontal tube projecting, its aperture invisible or barely visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length nearly equal to width; lateral corners of the labrum obtuse; median lobe short. Antennae 20-segmented. Postmentum not constricted, its posterior sides nearly parallel.
